subject: Weekly fleet & pipeline triage — capacity asks for Vertex pilot (RWD-4523)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly capacity ask — Vertex pilot (RWD-4523)

Team,

Sharing this week's ask for the Vertex pilot (deal RWD-4523). They confirmed a pilot start window of Sep 18–22 and expect peak concurrent sessions during the initial 7-day window. Raw numbers below (attached full matrix):

- Baseline sustained qps: 120 qps (chat generation)
- Expected 95th latency target: <250ms token
- Estimated steady-state v100-equivalent slots: 6 (8 for safety)
- Burst windows (3 x 2-hour blocks/day) will require an extra 4 slots each burst
- Total deltas vs. our pool: +8 reserved slots for 6 weeks, with 12 total burst slots available if needed

Ask: can Infra provision 8 reserved slots in us-west-2 for Sep 15–Oct 31? Finance: need preliminary cost estimate and whether we can offer a pilot credit (we discussed up to 20% cap).

Attachments: deal_capacity_matrix_v2.xlsx (breakdown by day/slot), mutual_action_plan_RWD-4523.pdf

Proposed next step: 30-minute triage today at 3pm PT to align infra, sales, and finance.

Thanks,
Ben

--
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly capacity ask — Vertex pilot (RWD-4523)

Ben — thanks for the matrix, looked it over quickly. A few quick notes inline:

- The steady-state 6 slots (8 safety) is reasonable, but our current us-west-2 pool has a 10-slot churn for other reserved deals the week of Sep 18. If we carve out 8, we risk contention for the other SMB rollouts on Sep 20.
- Suggest we use a mix of reserved + burst: reserve 6 slots (guaranteed) + pre-approved burst credit for additional 6 slots during the three peak windows. That reduces risk to other reserved customers.
- Need confirmation from Finance on whether burst usage will be billed at standard rate or discounted during pilot. If we can pre-approve a capped credit (for example: up to $6k), we can avoid last-minute escalations.

Action items for infra (Jordan): please validate whether you can formalize a reservation for 6 slots and enable automated burst up to 6 more with TTL-based eviction (so they drop after Oct 31). If there's a hardware constraint, call it out and propose a fallback region (us-west-1 or us-east-1).

Laura — can you confirm the pilot credit band you can approve without exec signoff? If not, flag the approval path.

I'm good for the 3pm PT triage — will join with the infra allocation sketch and proposed fallback.

Olga

--
Olga Petrov
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 13:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly capacity ask — Vertex pilot (RWD-4523)

Thanks — budget note: Finance can greenlight up to a 15% pilot credit on usage for deals under $75k ARR without VP approval. For RWD-4523 the projected committed spend (if pilot converts) is $62k ARR, so we're within threshold.

That said, burst consumption is trickier — we can pre-approve a capped pilot credit of $5,500 specifically for burst tokens across the pilot window. Anything above that will require VP Finance sign-off (24–48h).

Please include a simple one-pager (SOW-lite) outlining reserved start/end dates and the burst cap. Procurement will want that for billing and to attach to the PO.

I'll be on the 3pm PT call and will bring the estimated spend table.

Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Director, Finance | Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com
From: Kate Winters <kate@vertex.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 16:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly capacity ask — Vertex pilot (RWD-4523)

Ben/Olga — thanks for the update and for working through the numbers. A couple of clarifying points from our side before the triage: 

- Confirming pilot scope: 7-day initial pilot (Sep 18–24) with a soft production-like load for user testing.
- Data residency: can the pilot be pinned to us-west-2? We have customer data residency constraints for a subset of customers.
- SLA ask: For the pilot we'd like a 99.5% availability target and a runbook for failover if the region gets congested.

If you can confirm reserved + burst approach and the burst cap you plan to offer, we'll be ready to sign the MAP and share an internal procurement PO by Sep 1.

Kate

Kate Winters
Head of Product | Vertex Systems
